_NOTE: Dedicated S-band PSR for TC-03/TC-04 rain comparison. Symmetric to xband_PSR.json in every parameter EXCEPT frequency (2.8 GHz vs 9.0 GHz) and rangeLimits matches xband_PSR at 111 km. This ensures that when TC-03 and TC-04 run with the same gentle_turn targets at ~20 km range, the ONLY variable between the two tests is the sensor center frequency — which isolates ITU-R P.838-3 rain attenuation as the test subject. default_PSR.json keeps its 20 km range cap because demo scenarios rely on it for close-in geometry.
name: S-band Search Radar (2.8 GHz, rain demo — symmetric to xband_PSR)
